title: Representation Number 3 Classification
exact_target: Describe exactly the graphs that can be represented using three copies of every vertex but cannot be represented using one or two copies.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1434 (GRAPH-047). CC BY 4.0.
